svg.aria-label: Where to read first. doctor: WSL cannot compact, a run cut off at compact, a filesystem that records errors. The screen: Docker Desktop's disk in use. shrink: another run is not finished, more went than was cleaned. Each leads to the Troubleshooting section of that name.
